description: Draft automation labels: after 72h in the current Draft cycle, auto-promote only when exact-head required/material CI is successful and no blocking label is present; label catalog alone does not provision GitHub labels or install automation.

labels.name: keep-as-draft
labels.description: Canonical persistent hold: PR must remain Draft; re-draft if made Ready, and never merge until authorized owner removal

labels.name: keep-draft
labels.description: Legacy alias of keep-as-draft: same persistent Draft-state invariant and merge hold

labels.name: not-ready
labels.description: Not ready: prevent automatic draft promotion and merge until resolved

labels.name: overlap-review-needed
labels.description: Review competing or overlapping PR implementations

labels.name: needs-tests
labels.description: Draft or ready PR still needs substantive test evidence

labels.name: blocked
labels.description: PR has a recorded blocker needing attention

note: Fail closed for inaccessible labels, incomplete draft lifecycle, or missing/failed checks. A repository label must be provisioned separately; this catalog is not an installed ruleset. Existing keep-draft remains a blocking alias.
automation: At first authorized check at or after 72h of the current Draft cycle, if all material tests pass on exact current HEAD and no keep-as-draft, not-ready, or keep-draft label is present, automatically mark Ready. Recheck labels and SHA immediately before transition. Whenever keep-as-draft or keep-draft is present, fail merge eligibility and convert a non-Draft PR back to Draft; protect races with a required trusted governance check. Ready review age starts from the authenticated Ready event.
